description: A warm, slightly frazzled young Polish woman in her late twenties speaking Polish with a natural standard Polish accent: a friendly, bright village baker, quick and lively, clearly younger and lighter than a mother's voice.
text: Mój maluszek płacze i płacze. Nie mogę piec! Cisza! Śmieje się! Masz, maluchu, obwarzanek za to! Świeże obwarzanki, ciepłe, prosto z pieca!
